family_meta.description: Global wildlife classifier using the BirdNET v3.0 architecture (11,560 species, birds and other fauna; scientific and common names)
family_meta.author: Cornell Lab of Ornithology & Chemnitz University of Technology

requirements_note: requirements.min_ram_mb is a conservative, high-biased RAM floor: measured peak RSS + 15% where a benchmark exists, else a size-derived estimate biased high (a too-low floor risks OOM; a too-high floor only over-excludes on the smallest devices). Measured values will replace the estimates over time.
selection_notes: Regional models are the low-RAM choice: a region slice cuts peak RSS ~67% (685 -> 229 MB on RPi5) and latency 15-30%, and is numerically identical to the global model on the species it keeps. Prefer regional FP32 over global FP16 on memory-constrained CPU devices: FP16 is not a CPU RAM saving.

1.changes: Initial GPU-native export from the preview3.1 weights: the in-graph ONNX STFT op (no CUDA/TensorRT kernel, untranslatable by OpenVINO) replaced with an equivalent Conv1d framing+DFT; graph slim; fp16 variant; 39 regional slices on the Perch v2 region tiles. 5 s @ 32 kHz window.
